verses.text: I am the man who has seen suffering under the rod of God's anger.
He has led me and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
Again and again, all day long, he has turned his hand against me.
He has made my flesh and skin waste away. He has broken my bones.
He has surrounded me with bitterness and hardship, like a city under attack.
He has made me live in darkness, like those who have been dead a long time.
He has walled me in so I cannot get out. He has weighed me down with heavy chains.
Even when I cry out and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
He has blocked my way with walls of cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
He is like a bear waiting to attack me, like a lion in hiding.
He dragged me off the path and tore me to pieces. He has left me helpless.
He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.
He shot his arrows deep into my heart.
All my people laugh at me. They make fun of me in their songs all day long.
He has filled me with bitterness and made me drink bitter poison.
He has broken my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
Peace has been taken from me. I have forgotten what it is like to be happy.
So I said, "My strength is gone, and so is my hope in the LORD."
Remember my suffering and my wandering, the bitterness and the poison.
I remember them all the time, and my spirit sinks within me.
Yet this I call to mind, and so I have hope:
Because of the LORD's faithful love we are not destroyed, for his compassion never fails.
It is new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
I say to myself, "The LORD is all I have, so I will put my hope in him."
The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to anyone who seeks him.
It is good to wait quietly and hope for the LORD to save us.
It is good for a person to carry the yoke while they are young.
Let them sit alone in silence, because the LORD has put it on them.
Let them bow their face to the dust. There may still be hope.
Let them offer their cheek to the one who hits them, and let them be filled with disgrace.
For the Lord will not reject us forever.
Even though he brings grief, he will show compassion, because his faithful love is so great.
For he does not like to bring suffering or grief to anyone.
Crushing all the prisoners of the earth under foot,
denying people their rights in front of the Most High,
or cheating someone in court: the Lord does not approve of these things.
Who can speak and make something happen unless the Lord has commanded it?
Don't both disaster and good things come from the mouth of the Most High?
Why should any living person complain when they are punished for their sins?
Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the LORD.
Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven and say:
"We have sinned and rebelled, and you have not forgiven.
You have covered yourself with anger and chased us. You have killed without pity.
You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.
You have made us like trash and garbage among the nations.
All our enemies open their mouths wide against us.
Terror and traps have come on us, ruin and destruction."
Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.
My eyes will keep pouring out tears without stopping, without rest,
until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
What I see brings me grief because of all the women of my city.
Those who were my enemies for no reason hunted me down like a bird.
They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me.
Water flowed over my head, and I said, "This is the end."
I called on your name, LORD, from the bottom of the pit.
You heard my plea: "Do not close your ears to my cry for help and relief."
You came near when I called you. You said, "Do not be afraid."
Lord, you took up my case. You rescued my life.
LORD, you have seen the wrong done to me. Judge my case.
You have seen all their revenge, all their plots against me.
LORD, you have heard their insults, all their plots against me,
what my enemies whisper and say against me all day long.
Look at them! Whether they sit or stand, they make fun of me in their songs.
Pay them back, LORD, for what they have done.
Make them stubborn, and put your curse on them.
Chase them in your anger and destroy them from under the LORD's heavens.
